newsitem.title: USA: Reliance Bancshares to buy back shares.
newsitem.headline: Reliance Bancshares to buy back shares.

text.p: Reliance Bancshares Inc said Friday that it plans to repurchase up to 126,424 shares, or five percent of its outstanding stock over a six-month period beginning in late July.
Regulatory approval has been obtained, said the company, and the shares will be used for general corporate purposes.

Reliance added that during the same period it would purchase an additional 75,855 shares, or three percent of its outstanding stock, to be used as part of its retention plan to keep and reward key officers.
